# SF Memo

> The SF Memory Company.

SF Memo is building HBM chips for GPUs, AI Accelerators and SOCs.

Canonical website: https://sfmemo.com/
Contact: root@puul.ai

## Current work

- SF Memo's proprietary Verilog IP is active today with leading U.S. frontier AI labs.
- HBM research covers architecture and advanced semiconductor packaging.

## Research direction

- TSV-aware thermal management for future 32-die and 64-die HBM stacks.

## Objective

- A domestic path from memory architecture through advanced packaging to HBM manufacturing in California.
